nurse.text: Feasgar math, and welcome to Cairnryan Sanctuary. That's 'good afternoon'. You've come off the ferry, so let me guess: stiff legs, salty hair, team a bit queasy.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Sit down, I'll put the kettle on. The kettle is always on. It is a legal requirement in Scotland. I may have made that up.
All done. Taing for your patience, that's 'thanks' in Gaelic. Off you go, the road north is long and lovely.
The Ark terminal, in the corner. It's sheltered from the weather, and so am I.

else.text: Right you are. Beannachd leibh, that's 'blessings with you', or just 'cheerio'.
